JYM-GIT-CONFIG(1)               Git Manual               JYM-GIT-CONFIG(1)

NAME
       jym-git-config - Get and set repository or global options

SYNOPSIS
       jym-git config [<file-option>] [--type=<type>] <name> [<value>]

DESCRIPTION
       You can query/set/replace/unset options with this command.

FILES
       By default, options are only written to the repository config.

ENVIRONMENT
    GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL
        Take the configuration from the given file instead of the
        usual global config.
    GIT_CONFIG_SYSTEM
        Take the configuration from the given file instead of the
        usual system-wide config.

SEE ALSO
       jym-git(1)
